mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.tenant_id, t.tenant_code, u.username, u.display_name, u.password_hash, u.enabled FROM admin_user u JOIN admin_tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode} AND t.enabled = 1 AND u.username = #{username} AND u.enabled = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT u.id, u.tenant_id, t.tenant_code, u.username, u.display_name, u.password_hash, u.enabled FROM admin_access_token token JOIN admin_user u ON u.id = token.user_id AND u.tenant_id = token.tenant_id JOIN admin_tenant t ON t.id = token.tenant_id WHERE token.token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND token.revoked = 0 AND token.expires_at > #{now} AND u.enabled = 1 AND t.enabled = 1 LIMIT 1

SELECT DISTINCT p.permission_code FROM admin_user_role ur JOIN admin_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id AND r.tenant_id = ur.tenant_id JOIN admin_role_permission rp ON rp.role_id = r.id JOIN admin_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE ur.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND ur.user_id = #{userId} AND r.enabled = 1 ORDER BY p.permission_code
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_access_token (tenant_id, user_id, token_hash, expires_at, revoked) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{userId}, #{tokenHash}, #{expiresAt}, 0)
mapper.update: UPDATE admin_access_token SET revoked = 1 WHERE token_hash = #{tokenHash} AND revoked = 0
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM admin_user u JOIN admin_tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE t.tenant_code = #{tenantCode}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_user (tenant_id, username, display_name, password_hash, enabled) VALUES (#{tenantId}, #{username}, #{displayName}, #{passwordHash}, 1)
mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.tenant_id, t.tenant_code, u.username, u.display_name, u.password_hash, u.enabled FROM admin_user u JOIN admin_tenant t ON t.id = u.tenant_id WHERE u.tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY u.username LIMIT 500
SELECT id, tenant_id, role_code, role_name, enabled FROM admin_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} ORDER BY role_code LIMIT 500
SELECT id, tenant_id, role_code, role_name, enabled FROM admin_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND role_code = #{roleCode} LIMIT 1
SELECT permission_code, permission_name FROM admin_permission ORDER BY permission_code
SELECT p.permission_code FROM admin_role_permission rp JOIN admin_permission p ON p.id = rp.permission_id WHERE rp.role_id = #{roleId} ORDER BY p.permission_code
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM admin_user_role WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND user_id = #{userId}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO admin_user_role (tenant_id, user_id, role_id) SELECT #{tenantId}, #{userId}, r.id FROM admin_role r WHERE r.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND r.role_code = #{roleCode} AND r.enabled = 1
